description.subject: A painted ceramic or plastic egg-shaped toy figure with a drawn-on face of dot eyes, raised brows and a curved smile.

description.light: Soft, diffuse daylight from the front and slightly above, with a warm golden cast on the cliff and cool tones on the pebbles.
description.anomaly: The figure clutches a translucent ruby-red glass sphere, like a lensball, that holds a tiny inverted reflection of the beach and the two distant walkers.
